text:
alex_p: Quick thread — ACME pilot wants a predictable 95th-pctl latency SLA + ability to burst 2x for product demos next quarter. Need options we can commit to in contract today.

maya: Which pool model are they on? reserved or shared?

alex_p: Reserved pool, ~8x A100 equiv. They specifically asked for soft burst to double throughput for up to 3 hours/day during demos.

cheng: Two high-level ops choices: pre-warmed standby instances (paid, guaranteed) vs opportunistic spill to shared capacity (cheaper, not guaranteed).

jordan_se: From sales: customer will pay for reserved capacity monthly. Suggestion: a "demo-burst" add-on where they purchase burst credits that can be consumed intra-month.

maya: My proposal: allocate a small "elastic cushion" inside their reserved pool (e.g., 25% of baseline) with auto-shed rules. Policy sketch: allow 2x burst for up to 1 hour unconstrained, then ramp down over next 2 hours.

alex_p: Contract language draft for billing: "Burst credits consumed are billed at 1.5x standard token rate; monthly cap 180 minutes; unused credits expire at month end." Thoughts?

cheng: Ops notes: autoscaler must support a fast preemptible path + deterministic fallback to compatible model variants. Also need per-tenant burst-metering telemetry and alerting when cushion <20%.

ops_bot: [AUTO] quota-meter updated for tenant ACME_Corp: burst_credits_set=180_minutes (configured by @maya)

maya: Can we also add a fast fallback to a smaller quantized model variant to preserve latency while cutting cost? This requires per-tenant model-variant pinning and runtime variant selection logic.

jordan_se: Sales/legal request: simple SLA text and a monthly burst-usage report. If we cannot meet the 95th latency during burst, offer service credit or extra burst minutes as remediation. Keep wording simple for contracts.

alex_p: Action items (summary):
- @cheng: prototype model-variant fallback + perf test (target: next Tue)
- @maya: draft contract + billing terms for "demo-burst" add-on (target: Fri)
